claim_boundary: PASS is evidence of ordinal lifespan signal in the frozen linked/P570-resolved A1+A2 subset. It is not proof of deterministic individual lifespan prediction.

cross_cohort_deduplication.rule: Fail closed before P570 if the same linked QID appears in both cohorts. Current frozen pre-unblind audit has zero duplicates.

death_statement_policy.missing_P570: NO_DEATH_TRUTH; excluded and never treated as alive/LONG
death_statement_policy.multiple_statements: accept only when selected usable statements imply the same truth bin

evaluation.covered_eval: LINKED + resolved P570 truth + frozen prediction SHORT/MEDIUM/LONG
evaluation.primary_baseline: COHORT_STRATIFIED_BEST_CONSTANT_ORACLE: choose best constant separately inside A1 and A2, then aggregate absolute error over all covered_eval rows
evaluation.primary_delta: challenger pooled MAE - cohort-stratified oracle pooled MAE; negative is better
evaluation.primary_metric: pooled ordinal MAE across A1+A2 covered_eval

inference.bootstrap: stratified by cohort; resample within A1 and A2 preserving each cohort's observed covered_eval N
inference.permutation: shuffle truth labels only within cohort, preserving each cohort truth margins
inference.reason: Prevents cohort-level age/truth composition from creating a spurious pooled signal.

relationship_to_original_A2_protocol: This is a new combined-cohort pre-unblind protocol. It does not retroactively redefine the original A2-only preregistration.

truth_bins.MEDIUM: entirely on/after 32nd birthday and before 64th birthday
